ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) background with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, creating a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark field populated with high-intensity white blobs. Notable features include a large irregular white blotch on the mid-left lobe, a dense cluster of vertical white linear streaks on the distal right lobe, and scattered circular white nodes across the central surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Clear V-shaped median notch with an estimated pixel angle of 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge. Pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 5 and 15 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the inner-mid sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature trajectory originating from the central notch and sweeping outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular pixel clusters (ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle scarring; high-density concentrations are visible on the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of 7 distinct, parallel vertical white linear disruptions on the right distal lobe (rake marks). Multiple finer, non-parallel diagonal linear marks are visible on the lower-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake marks on the right lobe tip; dense barnacle colonization clusters on both fluke tips; large irregular white pigmentation patch on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the specific vertical rake mark pattern on the right lobe and the large focal white patch on the left lobe serves as a unique visual fingerprint.
